paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.18, with a change of -0.16% from the prior close and -16.03% over a window of 23 sessions. The price quote is as of August 7, 2026.

Recent news headlines include discussions of the company's CEO departure, financial losses, and potential agreements with tenants. A filing with the SEC stated that CEO Toby Neugebauer had left the company as of April 17, 2026, and an Interim Office of the CEO had been set up. The company also expects to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers and the disclosure of the resignation of director Miles Everson. A recent Form 8-K filing disclosed the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. Additionally, Cetera Investment Advisers raised its stock position in Fermi Inc. by 3,262.3% during the first quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing.
